name: pr-quest
description: Gamified dashboard for the PRs you're asked to review, with Cursor review agents

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.spec.json --noEmit
scripts.build: yarn typecheck && vite build && yarn build:server
scripts.build:server: node -e "fs.rmSync('dist-server', { recursive: true, force: true })" && esbuild src/app/server/main.ts src/app/server/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --splitting --outdir=dist-server --external:@cursor/sdk --external:@anthropic-ai/sdk --external:pg --sourcemap --log-level=warning
